verses.text: For the music director. On an instrument from Gath. A psalm of David. LORD, our Lord, how wonderful your name is in all the earth! You have put your glory above the skies.
From the mouths of children and babies you have built up strength because of your enemies, to silence the enemy and the one who wants revenge.
When I look at your skies, which your fingers made, the moon and the stars you put in place,
what are human beings that you think about them? What is a mere person that you care for him?
You made him a little lower than the angels, and you crowned him with glory and honour.
You made him ruler over everything you made. You put everything under his feet:
all the sheep and cattle, and the wild animals too,
the birds in the sky, the fish in the sea, and everything that swims along the paths of the seas.
LORD, our Lord, how wonderful your name is in all the earth!
